### Tools

| Tool | What it does | Read-only | Destructive | Posture |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `list_files` | List files explicitly opened with or created by this app. Use q="trashed = false" and pageToken for pagination. | yes | no | auto |
| `get_file` | Read metadata for an app-authorized fileId, for example file-fixture. This tool does not download file content. | yes | no | auto |
| `copy_file` | Copy an app-authorized file to a new name, for example body.name="Quarterly copy". | no | no | ask |
| `create_file` | Create metadata for a file or folder, for example name="Reports", mimeType="application/vnd.google-apps.folder". Binary uploads are not supported. | no | no | ask |
| `rename_file` | Rename an app-authorized file. Set body.name, for example "Quarterly report". | no | no | ask |
| `delete_file` | Permanently delete the specified app-authorized fileId; this does not move it to trash. | no | yes | deny |
| `list_permissions` | List access permissions on an app-authorized fileId; for example file-fixture. | yes | no | auto |
| `list_revisions` | List stored revisions of an app-authorized fileId, for example file-fixture. Follow nextPageToken. | yes | no | auto |
